306 days before 01-23-1475:  
1475 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Subtract 306 days:  
Jan 23 minus 23 days → Jan 1.  
306 − 23 = 283 days left to subtract from Jan 1 of 1474 (since going into previous year).  
283 days before Jan 1, 1474:  
1473 is not a leap year.  
283 days = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 273 days (Jan–Sep) + 10 days left → Oct 10, 1473.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1473-10-10
